message: Vector Rebel 3.2.91: two-month BC Check, BC-first station order, responsive update checks, and functioning Review All Errors.
releaseNotes: BC Check now displays all C-shift tour columns across the previous and current month, grouped by month, including future tours as NOT DUE rather than missing. Current-day citywide roster includes explicitly confirmed OFF members; station grouping begins with Battalion Chief then Station 1, 2, 3 and onward. Native PPE completions are summarized per person and tour as ALL COMPLETED, PARTIAL, NOT COMPLETED when a post-tour complete native history supports it, OFF when confirmed, or NOT VERIFIED/UNKNOWN otherwise. Completed with a confirmed failed answer is highlighted ISSUE, and completion-only without answer verdict is distinguished from a safety PASS. Existing BC review persists working and explicit OFF selections locally. Two-month historical reads use bounded pairs of existing C-shift read-only reports and do not submit official inspections, edit CrewSense, or send emails. Beta candidate pending signed-in field acceptance. Master Check for Update now shows a visible installed-versus-published version result or a concrete failure rather than silently changing a hidden notice. Software Issues Review All uses an actual async wait helper rather than throwing an unhandled wait-is-not-defined error after the first response; it displays progress and final acknowledged/error counts in the open dialog. The separate Captain cancellation path also uses the defined delay helper. Existing detailed error reports are kept, and acknowledgement never implies an underlying defect is fixed.
